description: Produce deterministic dependency order and diagnose invalid graphs.
turns: 修复 build.order_projects(projects)。projects 是 Project(name, dependencies) 序列。返回每个项目名一次，依赖必须排在使用者之前；同等可选时保持输入顺序。重复项目名、缺失依赖、依赖环都要抛 ValueError，并在信息中分别包含 duplicate、missing、cycle。不得修改输入。

provenance.note: Curated multi-file repository scenario authored for picli; not a captured user failure or official benchmark.
